profile.ja: “波遁の術”使いの対魔忍で、主人公だけに見える特殊な存在。『前世の記憶』の影響から、図書室でだけ彼女の姿を見る事が出来たので、主人公は彼女の事を『図書室の図書子さん』と呼んでいた。図書室に閉じ込められる事件や、謎の少年に襲われる事件を経て主人公や死々村孤路ことコロ先輩と交流するようになり、そのコロ先輩の“魂遁の術”により肉体を借りることで、“波遁の術”もより強力に操る事が出来るようになった。また、コロ先輩と混ざり合う事により、コロ先輩の剣術と紫水の波遁の術が融合し、新たな戦闘スタイルを編み出している。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin who uses the "wave-style ninja art" and is a special existence that can only be seen by the protagonist. Due to the influence of her "past life memories", the protagonist could only see her in the library, and so he called her "Toshiko-san of the library". After being confined to the library and being attacked by a mysterious boy, she began to interact with the protagonist and Shishimura Koro, also known as Koro-senpai. By borrowing a body using Koro-senpai's "soul-style ninja art", she became able to use her wave-style ninja art more powerfully. Additionally, by merging with Koro-senpai, her wave-style ninja art and Koro-senpai's swordsmanship combined to create a new combat style.
